summary: In late September 2024 an attacker exploited Bedrock's uniBTC synthetic Bitcoin token, a liquid staking product built by Singapore-based RockX, causing about $2 million in losses, mostly from DEX liquidity pools. Bedrock said the root cause was fixed, remaining funds were secure and it would publish a reimbursement plan and post-mortem.
